findings.claim: The change edits the shared `frontend/src/components/ToolbarMenu.tsx`, which is not in the touch-point list, and the edit changes how every quiet menu with `truncateValue` draws its value, not only the new view menus.
findings.impact: The quiet sort menus in the Video and Reading See all / shelf page headers (`VideoShelfPage.tsx:196-201` and `ReadingShelfPage.tsx:228` via `SortChoiceMenu`/`ReadingSortMenu`, which pass `quiet` and `truncateValue`) now render their value with `whitespace-nowrap` and no `truncate`/`min-w-*`. A long sort label therefore never shortens with an ellipsis. The spec says those quiet menus 'keep their look and get only the new wording'. Every outlined ToolbarMenu in the app also picks up `[&>svg]:flex-shrink-0`, and every labelled value picks up `min-w-0`. That includes callers outside this feature (OverflowMenu, PdfPreview, ArchiveToolbar, FilterMenu, TargetMenu's siblings and others).
findings.evidence: `frontend/src/components/ToolbarMenu.tsx:231`: `<span className={truncateValue ? "whitespace-nowrap" : "min-w-[2.5em] truncate"}>` inside the `quiet` branch (previously always `min-w-[2.5em] truncate`). `ToolbarMenu.tsx:223` adds `[&>svg]:flex-shrink-0` and `w-full` under `fullWidth`. `ToolbarMenu.tsx:250` adds `min-w-0`. Callers that pass quiet+truncateValue: `frontend/src/components/videoapp/LibraryControls.tsx:28-29` and `frontend/src/components/readingapp/LibraryControls.tsx:152-154`. The e2e-layout fixture `frontend/e2e-layout/fixtures/video-app.html:35` still models the quiet value as `min-w-0 truncate`, so the layout suite measures a truncating value that the real component no longer draws.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. By reading: render VideoShelfPage at a narrow width with sort `Date Added (Newest First)`. The value span is `whitespace-nowrap` with no min-w-0, so it cannot shrink below its text width. The real-component check `app-header.spec.ts` (375px, en) only asserts page scrollWidth ≤ 375 and the sort's right edge.

bucket_proposal.reason: This is an unplanned reach into a shared component outside the touch-point list. The 375px e2e check suggests no invariant (I10) is shown broken, but the quiet-menu look differs from what the spec states and from the e2e-layout fixture.

findings.proposed_fix: Add ToolbarMenu.tsx (and `e2e-layout/fixtures/toolbar-menu.html`) to the touch points, or confine the quiet-branch change to the callers that need it. Bring `video-app.html`'s `quietMenuValue` in line with what the component draws.
